Personalised Skin Tracker & Layering Guide – No Subscription!
One-off purchase • Automatically orders your AM/PM routine • Avoids ingredient conflicts • Diary with photos.

Transform your skincare and beauty regimen with a personalized routine! Skincare Routine helps you discover the best order to apply your skincare and makeup products, track your usage, and achieve your best skin ever.

The app comes pre-loaded with DECIEM (The Ordinary, NIOD, Hylamide & Fountain) products but you can add any skin treatments from any brand including Drunk Elephant, Pixi Beauty, Paula's Choice, The Inkey List and any of your favourite brands!

Note: The app price is a one-off payment and there are currently no subscriptions or recurring payments.



*** Key App Features ***

• CREATE YOUR ROUTINE

Add products to your routine. They will be automatically placed in your AM and/or PM routine as recommended.


• ADD CUSTOM PRODUCTS

You can add custom skincare products from other brands by selecting the option in the top-right menu in the Routine section or from the Custom tab in the Products section.


• USE YOUR ROUTINE FOR LAYERING ADVICE

The products are listed in the recommended layering order, along with advice for when and how to use each product.


• KEEP TRACK OF USAGE TO AVOID CONFLICTS

Each morning and evening, check each product off your list to keep track of which treatments you have used. This will allow the app to prevent any conflicts by showing you which products should be avoided.


• TRACK YOUR SKIN'S PROGRESS

Any time you notice your skin is looking particularly good or bad, you can make a note of it by pressing on the face icon next to the morning or evening routine. You can also add a comment to note down more details for your own record and add photos to track your progress.


• ADD PHOTOS

You can add photos of your skin to your diary tracker and also add photos of custom products.


• REMINDERS & TIMERS

You can set up notifications to remind you about your daily skin regimen. You can also set timers for products which require a specific wait time. Both can be found in the Settings.



*** Advanced App Customisation ***

• RE-ORDER YOUR ROUTINE

If you don't wish to follow the recommended layering order, you can choose to re-order the products to fully customise your routine by selecting the option from the top right menu (with 3 dots) of the Routine section. You can also change the order of the layer steps, for instance DECIEM recommends oils before moisturisers but some users prefer the other way around.


• USE CONFLICTING PRODUCTS

When we recommend not using a product due to conflicts with other products or because you've reached the usage limit, you can choose to ignore the warning and use it anyway. You will then have the option to permanently ignore conflicts on that specific product.


• SCHEDULE PRODUCTS

You can choose specific days of the week for a product if you wish. For instance, you may wish to make it so that the "AHA 30% + BHA 2% Peeling Solution" only appears in your routine on Tuesdays and Fridays.
You can also choose dates of the month, e.g. the 1st and 15th of every month.
Another useful option is to schedule products for every X days, so you could choose every 2 days to alternate.



*** Recommended for skin concerns... ***

• Dry & Dehydrated Skin: Achieve plump, healthy-looking hydrated skin.
• Acne-Prone Skin: Reduce inflammation to help support clear skin.
• Blemishes & Congestion: Reduce inflammation and brighten the skin.
• Sensitive Skin: Keep your skin moisturised with this gentle routine.
• Mature Skin & Wrinkles: Promote youthful skin and reduce the signs of ageing.
• Pigmentation Problems: Gently exfoliate and brighten skin tone.
• Oily Skin: Rebalance your skin for a healthy, fresh look.


Please note, Skincare Routine (previously known as "Skincare Regimen Organiser") has no connection with DECIEM, The Ordinary or any other skincare brand.

Build Custom Bundles and Save

Can’t wait to get your order? Track current order status within your profile to know exactly when to expect your product to arrive. Can’t remember which product you ordered last time? Earn Rewards

Chat With Us
Questions about your orders? Curious about what the best product for your skin may be? Reach out to us via live chat directly in the app and talk to one of our skincare experts for guidance and recommendations.


More About DIME®
The DIME Clean™ Promise means that DIME® is committed to providing clean and safe alternatives for traditional skincare and beauty products without sacrificing performance. We protect the integrity of our mission by aiming to use ingredients with low EWG hazard ratings across all products.

We are 100% transparent about every ingredient included in each of our formulas. Our products never contain parabens, sulfates, phthalates, or BPA/BPS.

To ensure every single ingredient in our products is healthy and non-toxic, we utilize an in-depth database from a third-party research group called EWG Skin Deep.

The EWG or Environmental Working Group is an activist group specializing in agricultural subsidies and toxic chemicals research. The group advocates for safer consumer products and transparency. Products and ingredients are rated on a hazard scale from 1-10, one being the safest and ten being the most toxic. We only use the highest quality ingredients in DIME® products with low hazard ratings from the EWG.

Take a selfie and get a personalized skincare routine. Use the products from your Plan regularly, complete daily tasks, adjust your lifestyle with our habit tracker, follow skincare advice, track your progress, and earn well-deserved rewards! 

Remember: acne is OK, and you are awesome!

Skinepic is not a medical app and should not replace professional consultation or treatment.


Smart Selfie Camera for Acne Detection

• Take a selfie of both sides of your face in good (daylight) lighting, following the on-screen prompts.
• Our AI model will analyze your skin condition, count each types of pimples, and highlight problem areas, if any.
Important: For the most accurate results, ensure your skin is clean and makeup-free.
• Carefully review the AI results: check both photos with AI masks on/off and the count of each type of pimples.
Important: The number of pimples is common for 2 celfies. 
If the model made a mistake or accidentally mistook a mole or freckle for a pimple, it's okay, just adjust the number of elements. 

Personalized Skincare Plan Based on Selfie Analysis 

•	After confirming the AI results, Skinepic will determine the severity of acne and create a personalized skincare plan for you.
•	Carefully review your Plan and the advice for choosing each product. For details, click on each product in the “Action Plan” section.
•	Regularly apply the products from your Plan and track their usage. Optionally, you can add other cosmetic products to your skincare routines.

Important: If you use the products prescribed by a dermatologist, be sure to add them, so that Skinepic is aware and can consider them in your “Action Plan”. And in order not to forget to use them, enable push notifications for these products.

Habit Tracker to Help Get Rid of Acne Faster

•	Choose what is about you in the "Habits" section and try to stick with it for at least two weeks.
•	Don’t forget to mark habits in the to-do list, so to not miss out on deserved rewards!
•	Keep track of how small lifestyle changes help  improve your skin condition and achieve the best results in fighting pimples!

Advice for Face Care and Problematic Skin

• “Why do I have acne?”, “What can I do to make it go away?”, “Сosmetics can cause pimples?”, “Diet helps?”
• Find answers to these and many other questions in the “Good to Know” section. Only dermatologist-verified and scientifically proven information, in short and simple understandable language. 
• Study the topics at your own pace, do not forget to click "Everything is clear!" (if, of course, it is clear), follow the advice and continue to improve your skin condition!

Daily Personal Missions 

• Each day, a personal mission – a list of the most important tasks – is displayed on the main screen.
• Complete tasks, mark products and habits, and earn deserved achievement!
• Take a selfie once a week and track progress in the “Trend”.

Important: By comparing photos in “Trend” from different dates, you can see improvements and assess the effectiveness of the applied products (but only if they are used regularly).

Remember: acne is OK, and you are awesome!

Our Love, Care and Support 

85% of people experience acne. Acne most often occurs in adolescents, but it can occur at any age.

• In most cases, especially among teenagers, having pimples is OK, perfectly normal!
• Anyone, regardless of age, can improve their skin condition!  


Skinepic will take care of all your problematic skin concerns and help you love.. yourself! 

Have any questions or just want to chat? Feel free to email us at care@skinepic.club
